_comment: Applied automatically at API startup by app/search/indices.py. Kept here so the mapping is reviewable outside Python and can be pushed by an ops pipeline.

notes: embedding is a knn_vector with the lucene HNSW engine and cosinesimil space
dimension must match INGESTION_EMBEDDING_MODEL (1536 for text-embedding-3-small)
changing the dimension requires a reindex, not a mapping update
